parsed.rationale: The structural evidence explicitly reports `shared_field_count: 0` and `jaccard: null`, meaning the two protocols share no common members. `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (line 20, HLSPlayer) exposes AVFoundation-centric members such as `currentTime:() -> CMTime`, `seekableTimeRanges:[NSValue]`, and `seek:(to time: CMTime) async -> Bool`, while `AudioEnginePlayerProtocol` (line 34, MP3Streamer) exposes audio-engine-specific members such as `installRenderTap:()`, `scheduleBuffer:(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer)`, and `eventStream:AsyncStream<AudioPlayerEvent>`. The only superficial overlap is the bare `pause:()` and `play:()` labels, but their signatures differ (`play:()` vs `play:() throws`) and the two protocols model fundamentally different subsystems — HLS/AVPlayer streaming versus AVAudioEngine PCM buffer scheduling — making any shared parent protocol semantically misleading rather than clarifying.
